summary.text: Claire Wilson is a Democratic member of the Washington State Senate from District 30, which she has represented since 2019, and she is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Michael Rutland (R).
She previously served on the Federal Way Public Schools Board of Education from 2011 to 2019.

paragraphs.text: Wilson was the District 2 representative on the Federal Way Public Schools Board of Education from 2011 to 2019 and resigned on February 26, 2019, after becoming a state senator.
In the 2023-2024 session she chaired the Human Services Committee and served on the Early Learning & K-12 Education, Senate Rules and Senate Transportation committees.
